title: Train What You Deploy:Token-Faithful Post-Training of a Production Coding
abstract: arXiv:2609.04678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing post-training pipelines for coding and terminal agents suffer severe token and control fidelity errors: simplified training environments mismatch production deployments, and offline token reconstruction from agent logs distorts original prompts and conflates policy calls with background model operations. We present a fidelity-aware training coupling framework that retains trainer-side sampling over original prompts, eliminates spurious model calls via a negotiated training protocol, and restricts loss computation to verifiable token spans with closed-failure guarantees. We further propose Certified Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization (C-DPPO), which establishes tight two-sided TV certification bounds, adaptive-K rules, budget-aware sequence guarantees, and error-robust policy masking atop standard DPPO. translated_title: 训练你所部署的：面向生产级编码系统的token忠实后训练
translated_abstract: 现有的针对编码与终端智能体的后训练流程存在严重的token和控制保真度误差：简化的训练环境与生产部署环境不匹配，且从智能体日志离线重建token会扭曲原始提示词，并将策略调用与后台模型操作混为一谈。我们提出了一种保真度感知的训练耦合框架，该框架保留训练端对原始提示词的采样，通过协商训练协议消除虚假的模型调用，并将损失计算限制在具有封闭失败保证的可验证token片段上。我们进一步提出了认证散度近端策略优化，其在标准DPPO的基础上建立了紧凑的双边全变差认证界、自适应K规则、预算感知的序列保证以及抗误差策略掩码。在TMax-100上，采用相同的训练与测试协议对匹配的Baize5B和Baize10B模型进行评估，C-DPPO取得了……
tldr: 本文提出了一种保真度感知的训练耦合框架和认证散度近端策略优化（C-DPPO）算法，解决了编码智能体后训练中的token与控制保真度误差问题，使训练环境与生产部署保持一致。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fidelity-aware training coupling framework and Certified Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization (C-DPPO) to resolve token and control fidelity errors in post-training of coding agents, keeping training faithful to production deployment.
